builtins.name: llm
builtins.signature: llm(model: string, opts: map) -> { text: string }
builtins.notes: temperature/max_tokens 直传；opts.messages 的 content 必须为 string（先 extract_text）

builtins.name: extract
builtins.signature: extract<T>(model, text, opts) -> { ok: bool, reason: string, value: T }
builtins.notes: 仅 prompt strategy；T 为具名非空 record；必须检查 .ok 后再用 .value；字段类型限 string/float/bool/string[]/float[]/bool[]

builtins.name: extract_text
builtins.notes: file 类型必须声明可提取扩展名（如 file<document; .pdf>）；输出字段为 text

builtins.name: http
builtins.signature: http(method: string, url: string, opts: map) -> response

builtins.name: tool
builtins.notes: 工具需先在 Dify 配置

builtins.name: knowledge
builtins.notes: 多 ds 用逗号分隔

builtins.name: split
builtins.notes: 大数组慎用（显式循环节点）

builtins.name: std.v1.rag_answer
builtins.notes: dataset-id 和 model 必须为字面量

operation_policies.name: retry
operation_policies.notes: extract<T> 不支持(用则报 E1045);白名单见主仓 operation_registry.py

operation_policies.name: timeout
operation_policies.notes: 仅 http 支持;llm 拒绝(timeout 实证 2026-08-13 e2e: OPERATION_POLICY)

operation_policies.name: default
operation_policies.notes: attempt 组合冲突(default policy cannot be combined with an explicit failure branch);default 值须匹配响应契约(E1045)
